domain: Logic energy per operation, 2026-2300 (CMOS end-scaling, steep slope, NTV, number formats, analog/in-memory, photonic, adiabatic/reversible, superconducting incl. cryo), for a Mercury-built Dyson-swarm AI system
summary: System-level energy per FP8-equivalent op on the compute sail (85 C, x0.6 clock): 2026 7.8e-14 J (4e-14-1.6e-13); 2040 1.0e-14 (2.8e-15-8.2e-14; IRDS x3.5 device, FP4, 3D/NVM locality); 2070 2.6e-15 (3.1e-16-3.9e-14); 2100+ 1.4e-15 irreversible, approaching the practical irreversible floor ~7e-16 J at 358 K. Adiabatic/reversible logic adds 1.5-4.1x by 2070 and 2.1-10x by 2100+ (memory and links reversible too) -> 2100+ mid 2.3e-16, low 1e-17. Its energy-area law (gain g costs ~2.4 g^2 more silicon per W) caps it at ~6x for 10 % and ~20x for 100 % film coverage, and multiplies leading-edge wafers per MW 9-110x (5,500-70,000 vs 640). Superconducting logic (AQFP/RQFP at 4.2 K) incl. 200-375 W/W cryocooling reaches 3e-15 J/FLOP electric in 2070 (parity with CMOS) but weighs 6-38 g/W (cryocooler 3-30 kg/kW), so its FLOP/s/kg is ~20-30x below the film's; it demands kW-class cryostats (pods) and gains nothing from a colder orbit (best reject 250-340 K). Falling J/op does not change film vs pod (heat transport sets that); it raises per-sail FLOP/s 8-250x, forcing 30 cm laser terminals and on-film photonic links, because wire energy (2 pF/cm) does not scale. Landauer kT ln2 = 3.4 zJ at 358 K; gate-level Landauer ~1.7e-18 J/FLOP; algorithmic ~3e-23 J/FLOP; refrigeration cannot lower the floor below kT_reject ln2.

model_parameters.unit: J per FP8-equivalent FLOP, system, 85 C, full clock (model multiplies by clockFactor)
system energy divisor from adiabatic/reversible logic on the film
model_parameters.notes: Optimistic/pessimistic: 2040 3.2/1.0, 2070 4.1/1.5, 2100+ 10.2/2.1 (2100+ assumes memory and links also reversible). Amdahl-limited by the non-adiabatic share; couples to siliconAreaPerW. FLOP/s/kg gain is smaller (x2.0 in 2070, x4.8 in 2100+) because thicker silicon adds mass.

Keep for irreversible logic. Adiabatic logic runs its gates 5-20x slower than a conventional pipeline (clock_rel 0.06-0.2 at the film optimum); represent that through adiabaticGain and area, not this factor.
Near the Boltzmann floor E ~ T^2 (2/T = 0.56 %/K at 358 K). Below 85 C keep -0.45 %/K. A TFET-class device (wildcard) would flatten it.
FLOP/s/kg optimum stays flat 85-105 C for irreversible and adiabatic logic (adiabatic.py: Tj 60/85/105 -> 1.77/1.89/1.81x). Analog and photonic prefer <= 85 C.

model_parameters.unit: mm2 of die per W on the film
model_parameters.notes: 2026-2040 irreversible (5-40; 3D NVM shrinks SRAM area). 2070 and 2100+ are the adiabatic film optima (adiabatic.py; range 350-3741 and 614-4497); keep 20 mm2/W if adiabatic logic is not adopted. The film offers 4776 mm2/W. Die mass at 50 um: 0.12 g per 1000 mm2.
2070/2100+ values assume adiabatic film logic (5,500-70,000 wafers/MW); irreversible logic stays at 80-950. Either way the fab, not Mercury mass, sets the build rate once adiabatic logic is used.
Film kg/W 0.924 g/W; 2070 irreversible (adiabatic x2.0 -> 8.40e+17); 2100+ includes the adiabatic optimum with die mass (irreversible only: 7.78e+17).

Needs on-film photonics or 0.1-0.2 V low-swing links (floor 2.5e-14-1e-13 J/bit electrical). Even so, FLOPs per hop-byte rise 47 -> 160-640.
Per-sail FLOP/s x8-250; at constant bytes/FLOP 10 cm terminals would weigh 0.05-0.46 kg/m2; 30 cm terminals 0.002-0.017 kg/m2 (design spec sensitivity).
Pod-only (>= 1-10 kW cold per cryostat); cryocooler 3-30 kg/kW input dominates mass; FLOP/s/kg ~20-30x below the film.

architecture_implications.question: (a) Does falling J/op or rising area per watt change thin film vs concentration?
architecture_implications.answer: No for J/op; mildly pro-film for area per W.
architecture_implications.numbers: J/op multiplies film and pod FLOP/s/kg equally (film/pod ratio stays ~5.1x at 2026 basis); the split is set by heat-transport mass, which depends on sunlight, not on J/op. Film FLOP/s/kg: 1.4e+16 (2026) -> 1.1e+17 (2040) -> 4.2e+17 (2070) -> 3.7e+18 (2100+, adiabatic incl. die mass). Rising silicon area per W (NTV 100-150 mm2/W, adiabatic 350-4500 mm2/W at the FLOP/s/kg optimum) fits inside the film's 4776 mm2/W and lets each die spread its own heat; a pod would have to stack 0.35-4.5 m2 of die per kW. The real cost of area is fab output: 5,500-70,000 wafers/MW.

architecture_implications.question: (b) Does any technology demand concentration or a different orbit?
architecture_implications.answer: Superconducting logic demands concentration (kW-class cryostats in pods) but not a colder orbit. Nothing else does.
architecture_implications.numbers: Cryocooler efficiency rises from 4 % Carnot at 1 W to 26 % at 10 kW cold: FLOP/s/kg improves 6.1x from 1 W to 10 kW cryostats, so the unit is ~1-10 kW cold = 0.4-2.3 MW electric (pod scale). Best reject temperature 250-340 K; inside a dense shell the radiator must stay >= 330 K or fly outside. FLOP/s/kg is flat 0.5-2 AU (2.0e+16 at 0.5 AU vs 1.8e+16 at 2 AU) and falls beyond (wing mass); a far orbit raises FLOP per J of sunlight only through cooler PV and reject (4.4e+13 at 0.88 AU -> 1.0e+14 at 5 AU, at 1.5x lower FLOP/s/kg), which holds for any technology. 2070 mid: 3.0e-15 J/FLOP electric, 17 g/W, 2.0e+16 FLOP/s/kg vs film 4.2e+17; FLOP per J of sunlight 5.1e+13 vs film 5.1e+13. In 2100+ the optimistic superconducting case (5.3e+15 FLOP/J_sun) beats the film's mid case (5.6e+14) but not its optimistic adiabatic case (1.1e+16). Cryo-CMOS at 77 K loses 3-14x. 4 K cooling needs helium, which Mercury lacks (exosphere source ~2.5e23 He/s ~ 50 t/yr).
architecture_implications.evidence_class: physics floor (Carnot, sigma T^4) + demonstrated (cryocooler efficiency/mass) + speculation (cold J/op)

architecture_implications.question: (c) Which current parameters go obsolete, and what replaces them?
architecture_implications.answer: See obsolete_by_era: the J/FLOP basis (by ~2030), FP8 as the unit, the +0.9 %/K slope, SRAM leakage share, wafers/MW, mesh hop energy, 10 cm terminals.

architecture_implications.question: Communication becomes the limiter
architecture_implications.answer: Wire energy is invariant (2 pF/cm), so FLOPs per film-hop byte rise from 47 to ~160 (mid) and up to 640.
architecture_implications.numbers: At constant bytes/FLOP: TP-inference mesh share 1.4-3.5 % -> 5-12 %; TP training 3.6-13 % -> 11-37 %; layer-local expert all-to-all 15-31 % -> 37-64 %. On-film photonic links (<= 50 fJ/bit) are needed by ~2050, or the film concentrates on weight-stationary, locality-friendly work. Pods do not escape this (switched fabric 9-39 pJ/bit).

architecture_implications.question: How close to the floors does the build era get?
architecture_implications.answer: Irreversible logic reaches within ~2x of its practical floor (~7e-16 J/FLOP at 358 K) by 2070-2100; that is ~400x the gate-level Landauer energy and ~3e7x the algorithmic Landauer floor. Going further requires reversible logic, and on the film that is area-limited.
architecture_implications.numbers: Gate-level Landauer 1.7e-18 J/FLOP; reliable irreversible 4.9e-16; algorithmic 2.7e-23. Adiabatic gain g costs 2.4 g^2 silicon area: 6x at 10 % of film area, 20x at full film.

architecture_implications.question: Junction temperature
architecture_implications.answer: 85 C stays the film's design point for every warm technology (optimum flat 85-105 C). Analog and photonic compute prefer <= 85 C; a TFET-class device would allow 105-125 C (film at 0.82-0.74 AU, -10 to -18 % kg/W). Superconducting needs 4.2 K inside a pod.
architecture_implications.numbers: swarm_node film_vs_tj: 60 C 1.10 g/W at 1.07 AU; 85 C 0.92 g/W at 0.92 AU; 105 C 0.83 g/W at 0.82 AU; 125 C 0.76 g/W at 0.74 AU.

wildcards.wildcard: Steep-slope switch matures (2D/heterojunction TFET, NC-FET, NEMS relay)
wildcards.effect: Vdd 0.15-0.3 V -> 2-4x lower irreversible J/op; TFET swing is weakly T-dependent (hot film 105-125 C cheap); NEMS relays have ~zero off-current, removing the adiabatic leakage floor
wildcards.source: Review of tunnel FETs (no thermal SS limit; low Ion and ambipolarity unsolved): https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC12388682/ ; Critical review of NC-FET progress (hysteresis, frequency, reliability unproven): https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.03884 ; steep slope tied to hysteresis: https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.02053

wildcards.wildcard: Fully reversible stack (logic + memory + links) with MEMS resonators (Q >= 3000)
wildcards.effect: System J/op 10-20x below irreversible CMOS if silicon covers most of the film; 4000x (Frank) needs >1000x the film's area at 358 K
wildcards.source: IEEE Spectrum, 'Reversible Computing Escapes the Lab in 2025' (up to 4000x claimed by Frank/Sandia, 10-15 yr out; MEMS resonator 99.97 %): https://spectrum.ieee.org/reversible-computing ; M. P. Frank, 'The Future of Computing Depends on Making It Reversible', IEEE Spectrum 2017 / arXiv:1803.02789: https://spectrum.ieee.org/the-future-of-computing-depends-on-making-it-reversible

wildcards.wildcard: Cold reversible superconducting logic + dense cold memory + helium supply
wildcards.effect: Pods at <= 3e-17 J/FLOP electric, 5e15 FLOP per J of sunlight (5x the film) for a sunlight-limited end state; He would come from gas giants or solar-wind capture
wildcards.source: Takeuchi, Yamanashi, Yoshikawa, reversible QFP gate, Sci. Rep. 2017 (simulated dissipation below kT ln2 at reduced frequency): https://doaj.org/article/35a3eb152cd640e3a0da43c9e26aaf82 ; Hener et al., JGR 2025, Mercury helium exosphere source ~2.5e23 He/s from solar-wind implantation (He released from regolith at ~400 K): https://wurz.space.unibe.ch/Hener_JGR_2025.pdf

wildcards.effect: Useful work per FLOP (sparsity, distillation, better architectures) can change ops/task by 10-1000x; hardware J/op then matters less than memory per site
wildcards.source: Epoch AI, leading ML hardware energy efficiency doubling ~2 yr (H100 1.4e12 FLOP/s/W FP16): https://epoch.ai/data-insights/ml-hardware-energy-efficiency

wildcards.wildcard: Analog/photonic beat digital by > 10x at system level
wildcards.effect: Would favour <= 85 C operation and NVM weight arrays already in the film design; photonic needs lasers and ring tuning on a 348 K sheet
wildcards.source: Murmann, 'Mixed-Signal Computing for Deep Neural Network Inference', IEEE TVLSI 2021 (single-digit fJ/op feasible for 4-bit mixed-signal arithmetic; DNN processors memory-access limited): https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10295527 ; Ahmed et al. (Lightmatter), 'Universal photonic artificial intelligence acceleration', Nature 640, 368 (2025): 65.5 TOPS (16-bit ABFP) at 78 W electrical + 1.6 W optical, six chips, 4x 128x128 photonic tensor cores: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08854-x ; https://www.hackster.io/news/the-bright-side-of-ai-ad44886a24cd

wildcards.wildcard: Sunlight-limited end state favours colder shells
wildcards.effect: Near any floor FLOP/J scales ~1/T_reject (Landauer) or ~1/T^2 (Boltzmann CMOS); outer shells at lower T compute more per joule but need radiator area ~T^-4
